rule: OBR fiscal year 'YYYY-YY' (6 April YYYY to 5 April YYYY+1) maps to the engine's annual period YYYY.
decision: cos d1344 (Max, 2026-10-15: methodology calls delegated to the workstream sessions with independent review); recorded in docs/uk_replay/HISTORICAL_DECISIONS.md

engine_evidence.where: policyengine_uk/utils/parameters.py, convert_to_fiscal_year_parameters; called from policyengine_uk/tax_benefit_system.py on parameters.gov
engine_evidence.establishes: Annual period Y is the fiscal year starting 6 April Y: each government parameter is sampled at 30 April Y and that value is written over period Y, for 2015 to 2040; parameters with fiscal_year_blend: true are day-weighted across the fiscal year (6 parameter files in 2.130.1); parameters with preserve_calendar_dates: true keep statutory dates and their formulas annualise transactions.
engine_evidence.read: 2.125.1 from its installed source; 2.130.1 from its PyPI wheel; 2026-10-15

engine_evidence.establishes: The same 30 April sampling in the legacy engine; the existing replays use calendar period Y for fiscal year Y-(Y+1).

alternative_considered.rule: fiscal year Y-(Y+1) = 9/12 of period Y + 3/12 of period Y+1
alternative_considered.why_not: The engine's period Y already carries fiscal-year policy (30 April sample or day-weighted). Blending two periods would mix two fiscal years' policy and double-count the April-to-March split the engine applies to its parameters.

limitations: Population inputs for period Y are annual projections uprated by the engine's indices; they are not records for 6 April to 5 April. Every comparison keeps the cy_proxies_fy divergence axis.
Cash versus liability timing (for example self-assessment receipts arriving after the year) is not bridged; it is recorded per head as a gap.

A measure commencing after 30 April Y is absent from period Y unless its parameter is day-weighted or explicitly dated; its timing limitation is recorded per measure, and no part-year coverage is claimed from an annual result.
A population built for these events must list every mapped period below in its certification's data_years, or the run stops with source accounting only (docs/uk_replay/HISTORICAL_ADAPTER.md).
